data.name: Eeshita
data.gender_notes: Eeshita is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Eeshita is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Eesha', which means 'goddess of wealth and prosperity'. This name is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and is often given to girls to bestow upon them the blessings of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. The name Eeshita carries the meaning “Goddess of wealth and prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Eeshita usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wealth and prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Eeshita belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of wealth and prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eeshita total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
